role: Gigabit Ethernet interface driver: the kernel's own messages call each card "the Gigabit Ethernet unit eg%d" and report firmware missing, full init done, link up and link down. Flags cs, prefix if_eg, depends on bsd. The kernel has if_egattach, if_egopen, if_egdetach and the character switch table if_egcdevsw (7 if_eg symbols in all). Its master file holds per-unit tables of 32 entries for the packet size, send and receive interrupt coalescing, the MAC address and mask, request_rrbs and link preference. The chip it drives is not named here.
